final_candidates.decision_summary: I20V selected as top due to general positioning in G; may stabilize structure for better F interaction without disrupting viability.
K14R retained for charge preservation at receptor-binding region; arginine substitution maintains basicity likely key for entry efficiency.
Q18L chosen for potential hydrophobicity gain aiding membrane fusion; position aligns with G ectodomain features.

stop_reason.detail: Further self-iteration unlikely to improve Top-3 without biological data; candidates from initial pool used as final.
